commit: # Bytecode-VM track. MUL = bytecode double-and-add (256 iters/multiply).
# Native interpreter is tiny; all EC logic is in 1-byte VM opcodes.
# Baseline is Thomas's ecdsa-p256-verify_stupid.S as received.

note: Thomas Stupid baseline. MUL=bytecode double-and-add. ~27× slower than limb8 890B. 124 B smaller.
op_ld/op_st share pop-pop tail via push order
merge skipcs/skipcc via cl==r8b; op_extended preserves cl
op_ok/op_fail direct unwind+ret via cl&1; drop END+check
MAIN modulus deref via cmov (always-read safe in frame)
drop xorl ecx in BEGIN; rcx=0 from entry subq check
bytecode check_zero_mod_m shared tail; check_point falls through
save sig/pub in r10/r11; r9 stays small; drop MAIN xorl r9d
movq rsp REG -> pushq rsp;popq REG for low regs
loop in z256_add/sub; op_add offset 32->30; +63% cyc trade
